pages.title: Stage-Five Ascension
pages.text: At stage five, fill the lingqi bar before taking an $(item)Immortal Pill$(). Success leaves one health, applies Advancement Weakness for three minutes and opens stage six. Taking it too early or unprepared is lethal. See $(l:immortalstorage:recipes/pills)Pill Embryos and Pills$(/l) for the full recipe.

pages.title: Finite Becomes Boundless
pages.text: Crossing into stage six converts every TruePower in your inventory and personal storage into ImmortalPower at 16:1, once. Kongqiao items move into Xianqiao at the same boundary. TruePower obtained later remains separate and is not converted again.

pages.title: Ascension Dan
pages.text: Ascension Dan has a 25% chance to appear in End Ship treasure and raises a cultivator below stage six directly to stage six. It deliberately has no survival crafting recipe: this is the rare shortcut.

pages.title: Beyond Stage Six
pages.text: A tribulation may begin only inside your own personal realm. Persistent cultivation benefits pause until it ends. Defeat the summoned enemy to advance. Death neither lowers your stage nor drops items, but removes the enemy, revives you in place and clears current ImmortalPower.

pages.title: The Four Default Trials
pages.text: $(li)6→7: Zombie.$(li)7→8: Wither Skeleton.$(li)8→9: Vindicator.$(li)9→10: Warden.$(br2)Each glows permanently, carries Strength III and has ten times its base health. Servers may replace these targets.

pages.title: White Day Thunder
pages.text: White Day Thunder is a special no-recipe item that sets the user to stage ten. It exists for Creative, administration and modpack-authored progression, not the ordinary tribulation path.
